create_motif_video_transformer: create a MotifVideoTransformer3DModel for video generation with configurable layers, attention heads, and patch sizes
build_motif_video_attention: build a MotifVideoAttention module with joint self-attention and optional added QKV projections for encoder conditioning
configure_cross_attention: configure a MotifVideoCrossAttention module for text cross-attention with RMSNorm or LayerNorm query-key normalization
generate_rope_embeddings: generate 3D rotary positional embeddings for video latents across time, height, and width axes
run_motif_video_forward: run the forward pass of MotifVideoTransformer3DModel with timestep, text embeddings, and optional image embeddings
